checks: Material list exposes actual history dependencies for archive/delete row controls
Normal purchase confirms in the single create/review flow, with no approval request or stock creation
List summaries start unpaid/not received and used materials are no longer deletable
Partial receipt/payment summaries reconcile live quantities, paid/outstanding values and pending Finance verification
Completed receipt/settlement enables Close, hides Receive and keeps Finance verification separate
Optional drafts and server-side pagination remain supported
Cancelled purchases do not display a supplier amount still due
Configured exceptional purchase authorization remains active on auto-confirm creation
